Initial release.

- First public version of the skill.
- Supports live flight tracking and aviation data via FlightAware AeroAPI through MCP.
- Enables users to track flights, view airport boards, check flight status, find operator and aircraft info, see weather, and manage flight alerts.
- Requires installation of the @chrischall/flightaware-mcp package and an AeroAPI key.
- Includes full setup and environment variable documentation.

flightaware-mcp 0.3.0

- Added new environment variables for configurable caching: `AEROAPI_CACHE_TTL` (live data) and `AEROAPI_STATIC_CACHE_TTL` (reference data).
- Expanded tools with new endpoints: `fa_search_flight_positions`, `fa_count_flights`, `fa_get_airport_flight_counts`, `fa_get_airport_routes`, `fa_resolve_flight`, and `fa_resolve_airport`.
- Updated documentation to describe caching options and new tools.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.

- Added comprehensive documentation and usage instructions in SKILL.md
- Clarified features: live flight tracking, airport info, airline/aircraft lookup, and flight alerts management via FlightAware AeroAPI (v4)
- Listed supported query types and tool functions (flights, airports, operators, schedules, alerts)
- Provided detailed setup instructions for both npx and source installations
- Explained required environment variables and AeroAPI key prerequisites
- Outlined dry-run behavior and API quota considerations
